name: fish-addicts-anonymous-timer-nodlc
title: Fish Addicts Anonymous Timer (No DLC)
author: Orbital917 (original); no-DLC port
description: Base-game port of Fish Addicts Anonymous Timer by Orbital917, with the Space Age dependency removed. Automatically saves and then closes the game after 1hr (configurable) of play time. Optional: carry time over between loads, and lock the save until you unlock it.
